offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures generic medicines, markets biosimilars, and sells branded specialty medicines, including treatments for neurological and endocrine disorders. It supplies wholesalers, pharmacies, and healthcare institutions and distributes pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to government and institutional buyers.

primary_products.value: generic oral medicines; generic injectable and other complex medicines; biosimilars; branded neurology and endocrine medicines; medical supplies

customer_segment.value: B2B: drug wholesalers, pharmacy chains, hospitals, and other healthcare institutions; B2G: federal healthcare agencies, including the Department of Veterans Affairs and Department of Defense

end_markets.value: retail pharmacy; hospital and clinic care; specialty medicine; government healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: generic medicines, biosimilars, branded medicines, and pharmaceutical and medical supplies sold through wholesale and procurement contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: develops and makes medicines for wholesalers, pharmacies, and healthcare institutions; distributor: sources finished medicines and medical supplies for government and institutional buyers

geography_served.value: global: primarily U.S. sales, with manufacturing in India and international commercialization partnerships

specialization.value: related lines: generic medicines, biosimilars, branded specialty medicines, and pharmaceutical and medical supply distribution

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: national pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors; direct sales: pharmacy chain accounts, institutional purchasing organizations, and federal procurement contracts; partners / resellers: commercialization partners in selected international markets
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA drug and biosimilar approvals, pharmaceutical manufacturing standards, and drug distribution licensing

notes: The full list of countries where Amneal currently sells products is uncertain.
